test_title: PYST 32: SSC MTS 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: At what rate percent per annum will a sum of money triples in 20 years on simple interest?
solution:
Given:

A sum of money triples itself

Time = 20 years

Concept used:

Simple interest = (Principal × Time × Rate) /100

Interest = Amount - Principal

Calculation:

Let the principal be x

Then, Amount = 3x

Interest = 3x – x = 2x

⇒ 2x = (x × 20 × R)/100

⇒ R = 10%

∴ The rate of interest is 10%
